dog.description_text:
💙 Meet Champ! 💙

Champ is a very handsome boy with a sweet side that's starting to shine! He's been warming up nicely with shelter staff and showing us what a good boy he can be.

In his previous home, Champ lived with children, another dog, and a cat. While this is helpful history, slow, thoughtful introductions to any resident pets will be important to help everyone feel comfortable during the transition.

Champ is looking for a loving home where he can settle in at his own pace, build trust, and enjoy being part of a family again. Could Champ be the new best friend you've been looking for? Come meet this handsome guy! 🐾
dog.name: Champ
